evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 3.3 ppm after remaining near 5 ppm during the ramp.
Oxygen increased to 11.6 ppm during growth.
Oxygen reached 32.4 ppm, a sustained departure from the established purged baseline.
Temperature 750.1 °C and argon 99.6 sccm track setpoints; pressure remains near baseline at 759.9 Torr despite rising oxygen; controller reports running.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and gas-supply/leak checks are needed to distinguish air ingress from contamination or oxygen-sensor error; no sample characterization is available.
